recipes.capture: Intent capture-create/title=intentTitle. recipes.step: Intent step-add/title=title with no implicit duration slot. New S={id:newId,kind:plan-step,planId:O1,title,status:planned,estimatedMinutes:25,createdAt:AT,updatedAt:AT}. Actions[plan.step.add{step:S}]. AFTER.steps=[S1,S2,S3,S]. O1.stepIds=[S1,S2,S3,newId],updatedAtAT,nextStepId remainsS1; O2 unchanged. Routeplans, no calendar/link creation.
recipes.outcome: Intent outcome-create/title. New S={id:stepId,kind:plan-step,planId:newId,title:Define the next action,status:planned,estimatedMinutes:20,createdAt:AT,updatedAt:AT}. Initial P={id:newId,kind:plan,title,outcome:Ready: TITLE,status:active,stepIds:[],nextStepId:stepId,createdAt:AT,updatedAt:AT}. Actions[plan.create{plan:P},plan.step.add{step:S}]. AFTER.plans=[P with stepIds:[stepId]],steps=[S]. Routeplans, one history entry.
recipes.commitment: Intent commitment-create/person=personName/title/direction/statusopen/dueAt declared or absent. New P={id:personId,kind:person,name:personName,createdAt:AT,updatedAt:AT}; K={id:newId,kind:commitment,personId,title,direction,status:open,dueAt:declared-or-undefined,createdAt:AT,updatedAt:AT}. Actions[person.ensure{person:P},commitment.create{commitment:K}]. AFTER.people=[P],commitments=[K]; routepeople oneH1. No invented deadline or calendar/outcome/capture.
